operating_notes.text: Cumulative investment in the Pyrova Energy platform up to March stands at approximately ₹79 crores.
Commissioned 8 MWp solar power plants at Ankleshwar and Panoli for ₹2.60 Cr.

timeline.summary: Rajendra V. Gandhi and Promoter Group declared no share encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26, filed 6 April 2026.
GRP Limited held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026, reporting a 3% decline in annual income to ₹538 Cr and recommending a dividend of ₹3.5 per share.
2026-10-19: GRP Limited commenced commercial generation from its 8 MWp solar power plants at Ankleshwar and Panoli, Gujarat, built at a cost of ₹2.60 Cr.
